lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
tasks_board-main: 2,623 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 2,020 B, @vueuse/shared 293 B, @vueuse/components 290 B.
tasks_board-dashboard: 26 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 26 B.
tasks_board-talk: 13 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 13 B.
All 3 pages load the same 2 files: 2,891,076 B raw, 730,867 B gzip, 99.8 % of the smallest page (tasks_board-talk, 2,898,092 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 711,306 B, moment 302,257 B, @nextcloud/dialogs 284,248 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 141,564 B, @nextcloud/timezones 126,980 B.
moment, 302,257 B on the tasks_board-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
9 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (140 packages, 1,376 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
